top_reasons.short_text: The numbered category line of the portal draft is missing from the sworn copy.
A declaration in the sworn copy has different wording from the portal draft.
The sworn land area is 3.5 acre but the application report has 4.5 acre.

why_summary: The numbered category line of the portal form is missing from the sworn copy, or lists other categories.
A declaration in the sworn copy is worded differently from the portal form.
The affidavit declares 3.50 acres of land; the portal form says 4.50 acres.
